sentences.en: The child's good health says a great deal for maternal care.
sentences.zh: 孩子的健康状况充分说明了母亲照顾得很好。

sentences.en: My maternal grandmother persists in wearing that old-fashioned dress.
sentences.zh: 我的外婆坚持穿着那种过时的衣服。

sentences.en: Layla was very loving and maternal to Sami.
sentences.zh: 莱拉对萨米非常慈爱和母性化。

senses.zh: 母亲的,母亲般的,母系的,母亲方面的
